retrievalProfile.description: A rustic, warm-toned portrait of a man in a cowboy hat seated in a wood-paneled room flanked by deer taxidermy, featuring heavy slab-serif display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in a cowboy hat and flannel shirt sits on a leather sofa in a rustic wooden cabin. He is flanked by two mounted deer heads. The scene is bathed in warm, directional light. A heavy, blocky slab-serif title is positioned at the top, framed by thin horizontal lines.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry created by the two deer mounts flanking the central subject
Warm color harmony between the wood walls, leather, and clothing
Contrast between the heavy, dark typography and the lighter wood background
Triangular composition with the subject's head as the apex
coreInvariants: Horizontal thin rule lines framing the main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure seated, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and cowboy hat, emphasized by the surrounding taxidermy.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top title, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the flanking deer mounts outward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with textures of wood, fabric, and fur.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans from the wood paneling and leather.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep reds and blacks from the flannel shirt and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in warm tones with deep, crushed shadows for a moody, rustic feel.
paletteRestrictions: No cool blues or greens except in denim

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, extra-bold slab serif and geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick, blocky slabs with minimal contrast
Secondary text uses a clean, wide geometric sans-serif
All caps for both levels of hierarchy
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for impact paired with a wide geometric sans for clarity.
graphicDevices: Text box container at the top

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif weight and blocky nature of the main title.
Provides the wide, geometric sans-serif look for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man with a beard and cowboy hat wearing a red plaid flannel shirt, sitting on a leather couch in a rustic wood-paneled cabin. Flank him with two mounted deer heads on the wall. Use warm, low-key lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large golden-yellow slab-serif title at the top, framed by two thin horizontal lines. Below that, add the artist name in a white, wide geometric sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the main title a heavy slab serif?
Are there two horizontal lines framing the top text?
Is the lighting warm and rustic?
Are the deer mounts positioned symmetrically?

adjustableVariables: Density of the wood grain texture
postGenerationChecks: Check that the slab-serif text is the most prominent element.
Ensure the wood texture looks natural and aged.
Verify the subject is centered and well-lit.
Confirm the horizontal rules are perfectly straight and thin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Portrait + Symmetrical Taxidermy + Heavy Slab-Serif Header
